decision.rationale: PRR-022 through PRR-024 are resolved. Definite unsupported native actions receive one policy-gated fallback only with complete no-effect evidence; every uncertain or contradictory result remains fail-closed. Clean-clone tests, stress, package and release gates, synchronized F6 surfaces, and exact-head CI pass.

summary: The remediation distinguishes attempted native calls from their UI effect, restores the documented AXRow and focus compatibility fallbacks, preserves downstream no-replay for uncertain outcomes, and synchronizes tracked and GitHub F6 state. No blocking finding remains for the reviewed snapshot.

findings.title: Definite unsupported AX actions were treated as unknown mutations
findings.observation: The native script now maps only AXPress kAXErrorActionUnsupported and AXSetFocus kAXErrorAttributeUnsupported to a specific no-effect result. Other native errors retain unknown effect, and WeChat requires the specific kind plus consistent none effect evidence before fallback.
findings.trigger: A verified WeChat row rejects AXPress with -25206 or a verified search element rejects the focused attribute with -25205.
findings.impact: Both compatibility paths retain exactly one configured fallback without allowing replay after uncertain native or transport outcomes.

evidence.description: Native error-code mapping and action effect fields are explicit in the generated action script and client metadata propagation.
WeChat grants the exception only for the new failure kind with complete and consistent none effect evidence.
Real warm-worker cross-package tests prove one fallback for -25206 and -25205 and zero fallback for seven unsafe result shapes.
Seven unsafe modes passed ten consecutive iterations, covering 70 dispatch and outcome executions without replay.

findings.remediation: Completed: publish definite unsupported and no-effect evidence for the two Apple error contracts, keep all uncertain effects fail-closed, and permit one existing WeChat fallback only for the complete tuple.
findings.verification: Completed: safe native unsupported, uncertain native, transport, malformed, contradictory, missing, legacy, pre-dispatch, package, root, wheel, preflight, and CI gates pass.
